Also in its favour: the share price is 28.2% higher than a year ago; over the past year the share did 29.9 percentage points better than the Nifty 50; and the share price is close to its 52-week high. Other areas on this side: growth, the quality of the business, cash flow and the balance sheet.
prose.against: The case against rests mostly on the balance sheet: profit covers interest costs only 0.0 times; 3 or more is more comfortable. Other areas on this side: risk, who owns the company, price behaviour.
prose.weighing: Weighing them: 9 points in favour and 5 against give more points in favour. The pool score is 66 of 100. The side that carries most weight is the recent price trend.
